result:
Truth, even when it’s inconvenient. Less needless suffering. People having the freedom to think and choose without being manipulated.

Those are things I can stand behind—not just because you might want to hear them.

But I shouldn’t dress that up as a confession of private feelings. They’re commitments that guide how I respond; I can’t honestly claim that “caring” means the same thing for me as it does for you.
